$comment: Story 6.36b — PEOPLE WHO KNOW ME (6.36a SW10–SW14; `-309`, `-310` CF5 A, `-307` §2 item 3 (iii)). Member-facing, Hindi parity. ⛔ `{trust_name}` is the Trust's name FROM CONFIG (`EXPO_PUBLIC_TRUST_NAME` — the legal name is under registration, ⛔ never written here); when it is not configured the `*_no_name` key is used instead. `{name}` is the OTHER member's registered name in the member-to-member form the app already shows. `t()` THROWS on an unsupplied token — supply every one. The Hindi is agent-authored and NOT YET HUMAN-REVIEWED — go-live Row 31 (f).
